name: knowledge-copilot
description: Local-first contextual learning sidecar exposed through MCP and MCP Apps

interface.shortDescription: Open an inline notebook and capture contextual learning cards.
interface.longDescription: A contextual learning sidecar that generates concise session titles, opens an inline MCP App notebook when explicitly invoked, and captures only authorized conversation turns.
defaultPrompt: @Knowledge Copilot 开启知识沉淀并打开笔记，标题由你根据当前话题生成。
把当前学习会话改成一个更准确的标题。
记录本轮并打开知识面板。
